system.description: The leap can reach the listed distances without difficulty or landing damage. To go farther, use the Agility test with the modifier set by the GM. Muscles must recover for 3 rounds (15 seconds) before another leap. This recovery does not grant general immunity to falling.
system.summary: The Ihana has the ability to leap with the incredible agility and grace of a feline.
